In the distance, 3 smaller ships appear near the horizon over choppy teal water, reinforcing the scale. The sea below is painted with lively waves and white foam. title: Winter Deer Papercut Forest
content: A highly detailed layered papercut diorama illustration of a deer family standing on a narrow forest path in deep winter. Show exactly 4 deer facing forward: 1 large stag with tall branching antlers positioned slightly right of center, 1 adult doe on the left, 1 smaller young deer in the middle foreground, and 1 young deer on the right. The scene is built entirely in intricate cut-paper craft style with stacked paper layers, crisp cut edges, sculpted contours, and soft dimensional shadows between layers. The animals are made from warm brown, chestnut, tan, and cream paper with delicately layered chest fur, white muzzles, alert ears, and small patches of snow resting on their heads, backs, and shoulders. Surround them with a dense winter forest of tall bare trees and fir trees, all rendered in layered paper silhouettes. Snow heavily coats the branches, bushes, rocks, and ground. title: Luxury Concept Poster Design
content:

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.

title: Anime Folding Bike Event Poster
content:
A bright, cheerful anime-style promotional poster for a folding bike cycling event, designed like a polished Japanese advertisement with dense typography, stickers, callouts, and event info panels. The scene shows a sunny riverside promenade under a vivid blue sky with fluffy clouds, green tree branches framing the top right, flower beds, bunting, drifting petals, and a distant modern city skyline across the water. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {{hair_color}} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

Fill the poster with Japanese ad-style layout elements. At the top left, a huge multicolored headline reads "Let’s FOLDING RIDE!" in oversized playful bubble and block lettering, with a smaller curved Japanese line above it reading "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！" and a blue ribbon-like subtitle below reading "フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！". At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {{search_text}}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
content:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {{reference}} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {{clothing}}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

title: Minimalist Educational Infographic Template
content:
A clean educational infographic poster explaining "{{topic}}".

[Overall Style]
Modern minimalist UI style, background in soft light colors (e.g., cream #FAF7F2 / light gray-blue), restrained and comfortable color palette suitable for long reading sessions.

[Core Requirements (Key)]
Naturally organize content modules based on the information structure of the "topic". Do not force a fixed number or order of modules; prioritize clear logical information over formal symmetry.

[Layout (Adaptive)]
- Use grid layout (auto-select 2 columns / 3 columns / irregular distribution)
- Card count adjusts based on content (usually 5–9)
- High information density modules can be enlarged (higher visual weight)
- Simple modules can be shrunk or merged

[Card Design]
- White cards (#FFFFFF)
- Rounded corners + subtle shadows (soft layering)
- Maintain uniform spacing and alignment

[Each Information Module Includes]
- Simple illustrations (unified style)
- Clear headings (strong hierarchy)
- 1–3 core explanatory sentences (avoid wordiness)
- Examples / comparisons / summaries provided where necessary

[Content Organization Principles (Emphasis)]
Auto-select appropriate structure based on theme, e.g.:
- Concept type → definition + principle + characteristics + example
- Contrast type → A vs B (comparative structure)
- Process type → steps / flowcharts
- System type → components + relationships
- Skill type → methods + tips + common mistakes

[Visual Hierarchy]
- Title > Module Title > Main Text > Supporting Information
- Important info can be highlighted with color or icons

[Color Suggestions]
- Primary color: Choose based on theme (Tech=Blue, Learning=Green, Warning=Orange)
- Secondary colors: 1–2 types suffice
- Avoid high saturation and flashiness

[Style Requirements]
- Generous negative space, strong sense of "breathability"
- Unified icons (linear or flat)
- High readability as priority
- Clear educational orientation

[Extra Optimization (Optional)]
- Can include: comparison blocks / process arrows / structure diagrams
- Can have a "Core Summary" module as a visual finale.
description: A versatile template prompt for generating modern, clean educational infographic posters with adaptive grid layouts and clear visual hierarchies. | Author: 知识分享官 (https://x.com/knowledgefxg) | Source: https://x.com/knowledgefxg/status/2048376335576510847 | Published: 2026-04-26T12:19:10.000Z

Lower-left-middle section titled "エネルギー残量 / ENERGY LEVEL" with 3 readouts: main battery 12%, backup battery 09%, estimated operation time 00:02:47, each using red segmented bars and bold numerals. Bottom-left section titled "外部環境 / EXTERNAL ENVIRONMENT" with 5 environmental readings: temp 42.1°C, humidity 89%, pressure 998 hPa, wind speed 3.8 m/s, toxic gas 7.2 ppm. Bottom-left warning strip beneath it with hazard icons and Japanese text "外部環境も危険レベルです". Bottom-center section titled "スーツ熱分布 / THERMAL MAP" showing a front-view human thermal body scan in hot reds, oranges, and yellows, with a vertical color scale. Bottom-center-right section titled "システムログ / SYSTEM LOG" with 7 timestamped entries in Japanese and English, including external attack detected, chest computer overload, abnormal vital detected, back unit link lost, energy below 20%, face guard damaged, all systems critical, and emergency rescue request sent. Bottom-right section titled "緊急警告 / EMERGENCY ALERT" with gigantic red text "!!! SOS !!!", Japanese text indicating a rescue signal is being transmitted, and a circular radar-like beacon graphic. Potting bench surface with soil scatter and water droplets.

title: Anime MOS Burger Promo Poster
content:
A polished Japanese fast-food promotional poster in a bright anime-advertisement style, combining a fantasy princess character with clean product photography and cheerful branding. The composition is landscape and split visually: on the left, a full-body anime girl inspired by a moon-princess or bamboo-princess aesthetic stands in a welcoming pose with one hand extended toward the viewer and the other hand near her face. She has very long flowing {{hair_color}} hair, large expressive eyes, and an elegant floral-and-ribbon hair ornament in dark blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her outfit is a luxurious modernized kimono dress in white, teal, navy, and pink with translucent sleeves, floral patterns, layered obi bows, tassels, and gold ornaments, with a magical sparkling atmosphere around her. Behind her is a dreamy teal-and-cream background with soft circles, starry sparkles, faint floral motifs, sweeping decorative lines, and a subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda.

On the right is a neat food-ad layout for {{brand_name}}, with the red MOS BURGER logo at the top left corner and again at the bottom right. At the top center-right, place a green ribbon banner with the Japanese text "モスバーガー特集". Below it, add a large elegant handwritten-style Japanese headline: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。" with the middle phrase "できたて" emphasized in vivid pink-red while the rest is black. Under that, add a smaller subheadline in Japanese: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー". 

Feature exactly 4 food items arranged horizontally across the middle-right, each rendered as appetizing semi-photorealistic product shots with soft shadows and crisp detail. Item 1: a classic burger with bun, thick meat patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large tomato slice, with a red circular badge reading "定番人気" and the label "モスバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 2: a teriyaki burger with lettuce and glossy sauce, with a green circular badge reading "和風人気" and the label "テリヤキバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 3: a white paper carton of onion rings with a yellow circular badge reading "サイドも最高" and the label "オニポテ" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 4: a pink milkshake in a clear cup with straw, with a blue circular badge reading "ひんやり甘い" and the label "モスシェイク" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. 

Below the products, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a teal border and a teal ribbon title reading "おすすめポイント". Inside, include exactly 4 bullet points in Japanese with pink flower-like bullets, describing made-to-order freshness, the appeal of the classic meat sauce and tomato burger, the Japanese-style popularity of teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and shake are also must-try items. To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

Use soft natural window light from the left, faint diagonal light streaks on the background wall, gentle shadows, realistic product rendering, and a premium e-commerce LP aesthetic. title: Anime Theatrical Movie Poster
content: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. title: Ethereal Buddhist Pure Land scene
content:
The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.

If some fields are not filled, please automatically derive them reasonably based on the [Theme]; do not leave the screen blank. All content must be generated uniformly around the theme, avoiding irrelevant elements.

[Visual Structure]
Adopt a clear isometric perspective / axonometric view, where the main subject is an opened multi-layer thematic building or functional base. Viewers can simultaneously see the front, side, top, and internal space of the building. The entire building is located at the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the subject.

The interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piled decorations. It can include:
1. Main work area / Core operation area
2. Display area / Collection area / Specimen area
3. Research area / Lab area / Control area
4. Storage area / Shelving area / Supply area
5. Living area / Rest area / Small residential area

7. Planting area / Cultivation area / Ecological area
8. Entrance area / Transport area / Maintenance area
9. Spatial connection structures like stairs, platforms, corridors, railings, ladders, etc.

Clear spatial relationships must be formed between various areas through stairs, corridors, platforms, pipes, bridges, or cables, making the image look like a real, functioning miniature system.

[Props and Details]
Generate a large number of relevant props based on the [Theme] and distribute them in different functional areas. Props need to be specific, identifiable, and thematically related, not just vague decorations. Each small object should be as clear and readable as a game asset, with a feel of being clickable, interactive, and collectable.

Types of props can include:
- Thematic equipment: machines, instruments, tools, consoles, containers, screens, workbenches
- Lifestyle objects: tables/chairs, bookshelves, beds, cups, boxes, cabinets, lamps
- Display objects: specimens, models, posters, signboards, glass cabinets, display racks
- Connection structures: pipes, wires, ladders, stairs, conveyor belts, slide rails, platforms
- Ecological elements: plants, water tanks, incubators, soil, branches, rocks, specimens
- Character elements: small number of characters, animals, robots, or thematic creatures to provide a sense of scale and story

The number of props should be rich but orderly. All props should serve the space's function and the thematic worldview.

[Style Requirements]
The overall style is clear, cute, precise hand-drawn cartoon isometric illustration. Lines are clean, edges are slightly rounded, colors are bright and soft, with an overall relaxed, healing, and exploratory feel. The image should have the feel of a business simulation game, a children's science picture book, a miniature model, or a concept art page.

Avoid over-realism, strong dark lighting/shadows, heavy oil painting feel, and complex noise. The focus is on being clear, exquisite, layered, and highly readable.

[Color and Lighting]
Use high brightness, low-to-medium saturation soft color schemes. The main color is unified, auxiliary colors are used to distinguish different spaces, and accent colors are used to highlight key equipment and small props. Line art colors should not use dead black; instead, use soft outlines like dark gray, blue-gray, or brown-gray.

Keep lighting and shadows lightweight; strong realistic projections are not needed. Build layers through color blocks, structures, lines, and local highlights. The background should use light colors and low-contrast processing to make the main building stand out more.

[Composition and Reading Path]
The main subject is centered or slightly upper-centered, with the building in a multi-layer cross-section structure. The visual reading path should start from the overall building outline, enter the functional areas of each floor, and finally observe the detailed props. The gaze can be guided by elements such as stairs, platforms, corridors, pipelines, and tracks.

The overall image should be full but not crowded, rich but not messy. Every room, platform, and corner should have content, yet still maintain clear spatial boundaries.

[Background Environment]
The background can include a weakened external environment according to the theme, such as a forest, city, street, underground rock layer, experimental park, seabed, space, campus, factory exterior, etc. The background should not compete with the subject; light colors, low opacity, and low contrast are recommended to achieve a 'subject clear, background receding' effect.

[Final Effect]
The final image should look like a complete thematic space concept map, with both the structural feel of an architectural cross-section and the detail of a game scene asset map, combined with the cute exploration feel of a miniature dollhouse. It should be suitable for serialized visual creation, IP worldview display, game scene settings, brand space concept maps, science content covers, or Little Red Book/Pinterest style visual posts.

title: Vintage Little Prince Space Postcard
content: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {{franchise_name}} and {{space_company_name}}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {{quote}}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {{tagline}}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.

title: Landscape Archive Model Template
content:
Please create a high-quality, professional 'Landscape Archive Model' visual based on {{subject}} suitable for a series.

This is not a regular map or simple landscape illustration, but a high-end archival visual combining '2D map drafting + 3D regional model + professional annotation system + museum exhibition feel'. The image should look like a real physical geography research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or world-building exhibit, with a professional, restrained, precise, and tactile premium texture.

[Basic Settings]
Subject: {{subject_content}}
Subject Type: [Natural Terrain / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape]
Core Subject: [Core subject, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark group, island city, ruins, main urban area]
Content Focus: [Content focus, e.g., terrain elevation / urban landmarks / road network / hydrology / nature-city relationship / setting collection display]
Style: {{style}}
Primary Color: [Primary color, e.g., off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand, snow white]
Secondary Color: [Secondary color, e.g., earth brown, rock gray, cool gray, light blue, moss green]
Accent Color: [Accent color, e.g., thin black lines, red routes, blue hydrographic lines, yellow numbered markers]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect ratio, e.g., 16:9 landscape / 3:4 portrait / 4:5 portrait / 1:1 square]

[Composition]
The main subject is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean tabletop or white cloth. The base plate has real thickness with visible section structures on the edges, like a refined map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained information layer, including contour lines, road networks, hydrology, zonal boundaries, geographical textures, a sense of coordinates, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area, a 3D model 'grows' out of the 2D map, becoming the visual core of the entire image.

If [Subject Type] is Natural Terrain: The subject consists of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, or coastlines, emphasizing elevation, layered contour structures, rock wall textures, and natural terrain undulations.

If [Subject Type] is Urban Space: The subject consists of the core urban area, CBD, old town blocks, landmark clusters, waterfronts, road nodes, bridges, water systems, or parks, emphasizing architectural massing, urban identity, spatial layers, and planning structure.

If [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape: It integrates both natural terrain and man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, apocalyptic wastelands, fantasy capitals, or sci-fi bases.

[Detail Requirements]
- Surface retains map paper and professional information feel.
- Terrain areas should have contours, slope layers, and depressions.
- Architectural areas should have massing, block relationships, and clear hierarchy.
- Water bodies use low-saturation light blue.
- Greenery/forests use moss green or low-saturation green.
- Road networks use fine lines without being distracting.
- Landmarks should be clearly identifiable.
- Sci-fi/fantasy elements should retain the archival model feel rather than appearing as pure scene illustrations.

[Annotation System]
The map board edge needs complete and restrained annotation modules, including frame lines, scales, legend areas, title areas, archive numbers, index marks, note tags, and simple symbol keys. Text doesn't need to be fully legible but must present a realistic, clear, precise, and orderly archival layout.

[Camera & Lighting]
Use an oblique top-down isometric or sandbox composition, with the camera at about 30 to 45 degrees, showing the map plane, model height, edge thickness, and annotation area. Lighting should be soft and natural with delicate real shadows on a clean background, avoiding a cartoonish or cheap game UI look.

title: Pixel Game Asset Atlas Template
content:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized release based on [Game Theme: {{game_theme}}].

This is not a regular pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview map" for game development, art setting, level design, and visual proposals. The visual should look like a complete game material board, systematically organizing core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, Bosses, and decorative elements required for a [Game Type: {{game_type}}] into a single clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas.

[Basic Settings]
Theme Worldview: [Game Theme]
Game Type: [Game Type]
Era Background: [Era Background]
Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity]
Enemy Types: [Enemy Types]
Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment]
Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g., {{style}}]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Secondary Color: [Secondary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, Landscape 4:3]
If not filled, automatically match according to the optimal plan for the game theme.

[Overall Visual Requirements]
The visual uses a large landscape canvas with a light or low-interference background, looking like a game development asset sheet or an instruction-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color scales, and retro game textures. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D rendering, painterly illustration, or movie poster styles. Focus on being "systematically complete, clearly categorized, resource-rich, and high in developability."

[Layout Structure]
The map uses a modular grid layout with fine lines dividing different resource areas. Each area needs a numbered title and short category labels, with a reading path from left to right, top to bottom. The layout should have the orderliness of an instruction manual or game dev document. Information density must be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be equidistantly arranged.

[Modules to Include]
1. Player Character Module: Show complete action frames including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc. frames arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet.
2. Enemy Unit Module: Design multiple enemies including common, ranged, heavy, and elite units.
3. Weapons & Items Module: Show melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and pickups.
4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Show ground, walls, platforms, corners, and different material blocks.
5. Natural/External Scene Resource Module: Show trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles.
6. Building/Base/Camp Resource Module: Show doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities.
7. Special Terrain Module: Show bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave openings.
8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resource Module: Show pipes, consoles, metal doors, and equipment.
9. Boss / Encounter Resource Module: Show large Bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms.
10. General Decoration & Interaction Elements Module: Show ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms.

[Visual Detail Requirements]
All resources must maintain consistent pixel size logic and worldview consistency. Clear scale relationships. Action frames must show continuity; terrain tiles must be tileable; items and mechanisms must have functional recognizability; Boss elements should feel oppressive.

title: Okinawa Summer Travel Banner
content:
Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {{headline_text}}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {{catchphrase}} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {{subheading}}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {{company_name}}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {{search_text}} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.

title: Vintage Fantasy Postcard of Beacon Hollow

The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. At the top center, huge bold condensed sans-serif text reads DOOM on one line and SCROLLING below it, with the word SCROLLING stretched across the page and partially motion-blurred or smeared horizontally. In the upper left corner, a tiny text block reads “SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.” with a short horizontal line above it. Below that, another statement reads “MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.” with a divider line beneath. The center of the poster features a glossy black smartphone standing vertically at the bottom center, seen front-on, with the bottom speaker holes and charging port visible. Emerging from the phone screen is a long impossible staircase receding upward into a narrow tunnel made of repeated translucent vertical panels, creating a claustrophobic corridor. Within the tunnel, a giant grayscale human eye appears in the upper half, partially obscured by haze, vertical slicing, and ghosted repetitions, as if trapped inside the feed. Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. title: Short-Form Attention Tax Poster
content:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {{headline_text}}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

title: Professional Brand Packaging System
content:
Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {{brand_name}} in the category {{category}}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.

Beneath Shiva is exactly 1 fallen dark-skinned male figure lying on the stone ground. The ground is cracked and molten, with a blazing ring of lava and fire encircling the dance platform. title: Food Lifecycle Infographic Prompt
content:
An educational infographic themed "Life of {{food_name}}."

The image must feature "a single complete food item" (such as a potato / a bunch of bananas / a head of garlic), using horizontal slicing to show the changes of the same food at different time stages, rather than a collage of multiple different items.

The main food body maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, presenting different levels of maturity in different slice areas (like time being sliced open).

The image is in vertical 3:4 ratio, with the main subject centered and horizontally expanded, evenly divided into 4-6 segments:

Each segment reflects real changes:

Color changes (green → yellow → black, etc.)
Texture changes (plump → softened → shriveled → decayed)
Feature changes (sprouting, weeping, mold, etc.)

Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions:

Stage name
Appearance characteristics
Internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes)
Consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible)

Design style:

Minimalist light background (beige)
Highly realistic photography style
Clear dividing lines (sense of time slicing)
Chinese educational layout, Little Red Book style
Appropriate use of icons like ⚠️✔️

Title at the top: "Life of {{food_name}}"

Key requirement: It must be presented as "slices of the same food item changing over time," not a collage of independent individuals.

title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll
content: A traditional Chinese calligraphy painting on aged tan xuan paper, landscape orientation, styled like an antique literati hanging scroll reproduction. The main composition is a large block of bold black semi-cursive to cursive brush calligraphy arranged in 10 vertical columns, read right to left, featuring the poem title at the top of the rightmost main column as {{poem_title}}. The calligraphy should feel elegant, fluid, and expressive, with varied ink density, dry-brush texture, thick and thin stroke transitions, and natural hand-written spacing rather than perfect typesetting. Use the visible poem text as written in the image, including its inaccuracies, with the right-side main columns beginning: “寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。都门帐饮无绪，留恋处，兰舟催发，执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。念去去，千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。多情自古，雷情自古伤离别，更那堪冷冷宵，酒醒倦兼芊？杨柳岸，晓风残月。此去经年良宰，经年，应是良辰好景。便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？” Place a narrower signature column on the far left with 1 vertical inscription reading {{signature_text}}. Add 4 red seals total: 1 oval collector-style seal near the upper right margin and 3 square seals stacked vertically near the lower left inscription area. Include a faint monochrome ink-wash landscape in the lower right corner with 1 drooping willow tree and 1 small pavilion by the water, partially faded into the paper. The paper should have warm brown aging, subtle stains, mottling, foxing, worn edges, and a museum-photograph feel. Overall mood is refined, poetic, historical, and scholarly, like a Song-dynasty-inspired calligraphy artwork photographed flat in soft even light.

Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. title: Hand-drawn Travel Journal Illustration
content:
Please draw a brightly colored, vertical (9:16) hand-drawn style "{{city_name}} Travel Journal Illustration." The style should look as if it were created with crayons by a curious child. Use a soft and warm light-colored background (such as light yellow), paired with bright tones like red, blue, and green, to create a cozy, child-like, and travel-inspired atmosphere.

I. Main Image: Journal-style Travel Route

Draw a "winding travel route" in the center of the illustration, connecting multiple locations with arrows and dashed lines. Recommended attractions will be automatically generated based on a {{number_of_days}}-day itinerary:

Example format (automatically replaced with {{city_name}} related content):

- "Stop 1: {Attraction 1 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 2: {Attraction 2 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 3: {Attraction 3 recommendation + short fun description}"
- ...
- "Final Stop: {Local signature food/souvenir + warm closing statement}"

The number of travel stops is automatically generated based on the number of days. If no days are input, a 1-day/highlights route will be generated by default.

II. Fun Surrounding Elements (Automatically replaced based on the city)

Add plenty of child-like elements around the route, such as:

- Cute travel characters: "A child holding local snacks," "An adventurous kid wearing a backpack," etc.
- Child-like Q-version hand-drawings of local landmarks: such as "{landmark 1}," "{landmark 2}," "{landmark 3}."
- Fun signboards: "Watch out for getting lost!", "Mind the crowds!", "Good food ahead!" (Adjusted according to city context).
- Sticker-style slogans: "{{city_name}} Travel Memories Unlocked!", "{{city_name}} Food Adventure!", "Where to next?"
- Cute small icons of local delicacies: such as "{food 1}," "{food 2}," "{food 3}."
- Exclamations (maintaining a child-like tone): "{{city_name}} is so much fun!", "I want to go again!"

III. Overall Style Requirements

- Hand-drawn crayon style / children's travel log style
- Bright colors, full but warm composition
- Emphasis on the joy and exploration of travel
- All text uses cute handwritten fonts
- Make the entire image look like a travel journal page full of child-like wonder.

title: Cyber Streetwear Manga Splash Art
content: A dynamic manga-style action illustration of a single androgynous young woman shot from a dramatic low angle, as if the viewer is beneath her while she drops or steps forward through an explosive burst of ink and debris. She has a short platinum-blonde bob haircut with long side-swept bangs partly covering one side of her face, pale skin, and a cool, rebellious streetwear aesthetic. Her face is obscured by a simple light-gray rectangular censor block. She wears 5 main clothing items: an oversized black hooded jacket with bright cyan geometric markings on the sleeve and inner lining, a fitted white tank top, loose black cargo-style pants with straps and zipper details, a black belt with a hanging cyan tag, and chunky white-and-black sneakers with small cyan accents. Add extra accessory details including dangling straps, buckles, and street-tech trims. Her pose is relaxed but dominant, one knee raised toward the viewer, torso leaning back slightly, one hand tucked into a pocket, jacket flaring outward in motion. The composition should feel aggressive and kinetic, with a monochrome palette of black, white, and gray, punctuated by vivid electric cyan paint slashes. Fill the background with explosive abstract brushwork, ink splatter, speed lines, torn black shards, and chaotic manga energy radiating outward from behind her. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.

title: Anime Maid Thriller Movie Poster
content: A dramatic anime theatrical movie poster in a tall vertical composition, centered on 2 young women in classic black-and-white maid uniforms standing back-to-back and facing opposite directions. The left maid has a short silver bob haircut with straight bangs and a white maid headband; the right maid has a short vivid pink bob haircut with straight bangs and a matching white maid headband. Both wear fitted black dresses with puff sleeves, white aprons with ruffled trim, white collars and cuffs, and black ribbon accents at the neck. Their poses are confident and tense, with one hand lowered at their sides, suggesting mystery and rivalry. Place them large in the foreground, filling most of the poster height. Behind them, create a split-color night sky: deep electric blue on the left and saturated magenta-pink on the right, blending at the center. In the upper left, show a bright full moon and a small helicopter with a searchlight. Along the horizon and lower sides, include a glowing city skyline, blue-lit on the left and pink-lit on the right. In the center background, place a gothic mansion or castle with pointed towers at the end of a path, illuminated with warm lights. In front of the mansion, show 2 smaller full-body figures of the same maids from behind, walking toward the building side by side. Add 4 supporting characters around the lower edges: 1 dark-haired man in a suit at bottom left, 1 older stern man in a suit at lower right-center, 1 young woman with long dark hair at bottom right, and the 2 small maid figures in the center distance, for a total of 6 visible human figures in the poster. Scatter bright pink flower petals across the image as if blown by the wind. Use intense cinematic lighting, glossy anime rendering, high contrast, sharp linework, glowing rim light, and a suspenseful psychological thriller mood. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on both sides, a large stylized title at the bottom center reading {{title_text}}, smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and release text at the lower left reading {{release_date_text}}. Add a final Japanese tagline line along the bottom. Overall style: premium anime key visual, mystery thriller, neon blue and hot pink dual-color palette, polished poster typography, highly detailed background, dynamic petals, and theatrical film-poster finish.

title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
content:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {{celebrity_spokesperson}} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.

title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt
content:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {{product_name}}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {{product_name}}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.

title: Censored Office Manga Confrontation
content: A dramatic black-and-white manga page in a seinen style, rendered with dense screentones, sharp ink lines, high contrast lighting, and expressive Japanese comic layout. The page has 4 stacked panels with vertical Japanese speech bubbles and bold sound effects, showing a tense confrontation between two office workers in a modern workspace. In the top panel, a young woman with a short messy bob haircut, slim but curvy build, wearing a fitted button-up blouse with rolled sleeves and a dark pencil skirt, slams one hand hard onto a desk in anger, leaning forward toward the viewer with explosive impact lines and a large jagged speech bubble. In the second panel, a young man with dark tousled hair, slim build, wearing a black leather jacket over a light shirt and a necklace, is shown from the chest up in a calm, confident pose, touching his face while speaking. In the third panel, the man pins the woman against a wall in a close, intimate kabedon pose, one arm braced beside her head; she looks flustered and tense while he speaks near her face, creating a sudden romantic-comedic shift in mood. In the bottom panel, an overhead view reveals the office setting: 2 characters standing near a desk with 1 computer monitor, 1 keyboard, 1 mouse, 1 office chair, and scattered papers on a tiled floor; the woman is curled inward shyly and trembling while the man stands relaxed beside her. Include exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 visible speech bubbles total, and visible Japanese manga typography throughout. Add a rectangular mosaic censor blur over each character's face in every panel, as if anonymized for sharing online. Background details should include office walls, desk edges, speed lines, burst effects, and tonal gradients. The overall feeling is intense argument turning into manipulative flirtation, like a viral out-of-context manga screenshot.

title: Historical Invention Timeline Grid
content:

Use a warm antiquarian palette for ancient and medieval inventions, sepia technical-document tones for early modern inventions, and cooler neon-blue futuristic lighting for modern digital and biotech inventions. Surround the grid with an old-map border and subtle historical cartography textures, blending into faint modern network graphics near the bottom right.

Label each visible tile with a small beige caption tag in bold black text. Include exactly these 25 visible inventions in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1) {{first_tile_label}} tile showing an iron plow and simple hand tools in a farm field, captioned "Iron Plow & Tools"; 2) "Concept of Zero" shown as a parchment-like tile with a carved zero symbol and a blue hourglass; 3) "Water Clock" shown as a wooden water-timing device; 4) "Catapult" shown as a wooden siege engine; 5) "Antikythera Mechanism" shown as an intricate bronze gear device in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete" shown as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheelbarrow" shown as a simple wooden one-wheel cart; Keep the composition highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense, with each tile readable at a glance. title: Sengoku vs Sangoku Crossover Poster
content:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {{left_faction_title}}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {{right_faction_title}}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {{center_slogan}}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {{bottom_tagline}}. title: Low-Angle Anime Bunny Girls in Ruins
content: A dynamic anime-style low-angle illustration of two young women in rabbit-themed bodysuits, viewed from below as if the camera is tilted upward and they are looking slightly down toward the viewer. The left girl has {{hair_color}} hair in short twin pigtails with curled ends, large red bunny ears, and a glossy bright red high-cut bodysuit with puff sleeves, long opera gloves, a sweetheart-shaped chest panel, and 4 round silver button-like discs on the front. The right girl has long straight brown hair, pale bunny ears, and a glossy white and pale pink version of the same bodysuit design, also with puff sleeves, long gloves, sweetheart chest panel, and 4 round silver discs. Both have slim builds, long legs, expressive wide anime eyes, and mildly surprised, curious expressions as they glance toward each other and slightly toward the viewer. Their hands hang loosely at their sides, almost touching in the center. Place them in front of a vast ruined cathedral or decayed grand stone building with broken arches, skeletal metal framework, shattered windows, and crumbling debris, rendered as a soft-painted anime background. Use a dramatic Dutch angle and strong perspective so the architecture leans with the camera tilt and the characters feel towering and close to the lens. Bright blue sky with large white clouds behind the ruins. Clean cel shading on the characters, painterly detailed background, crisp line art, vibrant but slightly weathered color palette, cinematic composition. Add 3 text elements in the upper right area as graphic design overlay: small uppercase text "ARINKO AGENTS", large bold Japanese text "平和島", and a large white handwritten signature-like script overlapping the background.

title: Vintage Chinese SpaceX Propaganda Poster
content: A vintage socialist propaganda poster in a mid-20th-century Chinese style, printed on aged paper with a warm sepia tint, distressed texture, faded ink, and slightly worn edges. The composition is vertical and heroic. On the right half of the poster, show a large waist-up portrait of a male worker or revolutionary figure wearing a dark cap and a dark utilitarian jacket, facing slightly to the left with a stoic, determined expression. On the left-center, a white reusable rocket rises upward with bright engine flame, depicted like an aspirational symbol of technological progress; the rocket has the word "SPACEX" written vertically on its body and visible landing legs near the base. Behind the rocket, fill the sky with dramatic cream-colored sunburst rays spreading outward across a muted blue background. In the lower left, include a cheering crowd of exactly 6 factory workers or citizens in blue-gray uniforms, raising their hands in celebration, with one large red flag waving beside them. Add faint industrial city elements and launch-tower silhouettes behind the crowd. At the bottom, reserve a wide text panel with large bold red Chinese slogan lettering in two lines reading: "今天回收火箭，明天建设星际家园！". Use a screen-printed poster look, painterly realism, limited palette of dusty blue, cream, brick red, and dark olive, with strong ideological poster composition, triumphant mood, and retro-futurist space-race symbolism.

title: Anime Martial Arts Dojo Duel
content: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text {{sign_text}}. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading {{watermark_text}}.

content: A photorealistic selfie on the surface of Mars, framed at arm’s length in a casual slightly wide-angle smartphone perspective. The man has short dark messy hair and his left arm extends toward the camera as if taking the selfie. The alien leans in close beside him, both posed like a friendly commemorative snapshot. The background is a red rocky Martian desert with scattered stones, low hills, and a dusty orange sunset sky. On the far left stands a roadside-style sign with 2 lines of text reading {{sign_headline}} and {{sign_subtext}}. On the far right in the distance is 1 large retro-futuristic white rocket standing upright on landing legs, with visible vertical text reading {{rocket_text}}. title: Zombie Survival RPG Anime Ad Poster
content:
Create a dramatic Japanese mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG in anime-meets-cinematic style. Vertical smartphone poster layout, dense promotional design, gritty urban apocalypse background at dusk with ruined city streets, smoke, sparks, debris, damaged buildings, neon signs, and a crowd of zombies advancing from behind. In the center, a young anime woman sits on the ground in a slightly slouched pose, legs bent, holding a black handgun upright in one hand. She has straight dark brown to black shoulder-length hair, pale skin, and an oversized dirty white T-shirt splattered with blood. Large bold Japanese calligraphy is printed vertically on the shirt: "働きたくね〜". Her expression area is simple and unobtrusive so the composition emphasizes the shirt, weapon, and mood. Surround her with multiple zombies in torn clothing, reaching forward from the left and right background.

Use an aggressive game key-art design with 8 clearly separated promotional sections. Section 1: top-left game logo block, count 3 text elements, with large distressed English title "Dead or work", smaller Japanese subtitle "ゾンビサバイバルRPG", and heavy black paint-splatter background with white and red text. Section 2: right-side vertical slogan area, count 2 text elements, with white Japanese text "動かない、ただ" above giant red vertical text "生き残れ。" on a rough black brushstroke strip. Section 3: left-middle feature list panel, count 4 feature rows, each row with a white icon in a black square and yellow/white Japanese copy; labels are "ゾンビを倒して生き延びろ", "拠点を強化・カスタマイズ", "仲間と協力プレイ", and "デイリーミッションで報酬GET". Section 4: right-middle bonus campaign panel, count 1 headline plus 3 reward items; headline in a bright jagged yellow burst says "今すぐ始めると 豪華特典プレゼント!" and beneath it are three item boxes labeled "ゴールド ×5000", "レア武器 (7日間)", and "サバイバルキット ×10". Section 5: lower-middle gameplay screenshot strip, count 4 thumbnails with captions; captions are "リアルタイムバトル!", "基地を自由にカスタム!", "仲間とレイドボスに挑め!", and "広大なオープンワールド!". Section 6: bottom call-to-action banner, count 2 text elements, with a huge yellow-and-red Japanese phrase "今すぐダウンロード!" and smaller white/red subtext "あなたの選択が、生死を分ける。". Section 7: bottom-right store badges, count 2 badges, showing App Store and Google Play style download buttons. Section 8: bottom-right QR area, count 1 QR code in a white square.

Overall aesthetic: hyper-detailed, high-contrast, grimy, intense, commercially polished gacha/mobile game ad, combining anime character art with realistic zombie horror background. Use bold distressed typography, black brush textures, red warning colors, yellow promotional highlights, metallic UI framing, and cinematic orange-gray lighting.
